commentaries.griffith: WITH worship will I glorify thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial Lord of sacred rites.
commentaries.oldenberg: With reverence I shall worship thee who art long-tailed like a horse, Agni, the king of worship.
commentaries.geldner: Wie ein wertvolles Roß will ich unter Verbeugungen dich, den Agni, loben, der über allen Opferhandlungen waltet.
commentaries.grassmann: Den Agni rühmet andachtsvoll gleichwie ein langgeschweiftes Ross, Der über alle Opfer herrscht.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Как коня, приносящего награды, / Надо почитать тебя, Агни, поклонениями, / (Тебя,) безраздельно властвующего над обрядами.

items.samhita_patha_plain: अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः । सम्राजन्तमध्वराणाम् ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: अश्वम् । न । त्वा । वारऽवन्तम् । वन्दध्यै । अग्निम् । नमोभिः । सम्ऽराजन्तम् । अध्वराणाम् ॥

items.samhita_patha: स घा॑ नः सू॒नुः शव॑सा पृ॒थुप्र॑गामा सु॒शेवः॑ । मी॒ढ्वाँ अ॒स्माकं॑ बभूयात् ॥
items.pada_patha: सः । घ॒ । नः॒ । सू॒नुः । शव॑सा । पृ॒थुऽप्र॑गामा । सु॒ऽशेवः॑ । मी॒ढ्वान् । अ॒स्माक॑म् । ब॒भू॒या॒त् ॥

commentaries.griffith: May the far-striding Son of Strength, bringer of great felicity, Who pours his gifts like rain, be ours.
commentaries.oldenberg: May he, our son of strength 1, proceeding on his broad way, the propitious, become bountiful to us.
commentaries.geldner: Er, unser Sohn durch Kraft, der breitbahnige, freundliche sei uns ein Belohner.
commentaries.grassmann: Und er, der krafterzeugte Sohn, der holde, weithinschreitende, Er möge segensreich uns sein.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Пусть же этот наш (Агни), сын (силы), с силой (своей), / Широко продвигающийся, очень благосклонный, / Щедрый, будет с нами!

items.samhita_patha_plain: स घा नः सूनुः शवसा पृथुप्रगामा सुशेवः । मीढ्वाँ अस्माकं बभूयात् ॥

items.samhita_patha: स नो॑ दू॒राच्चा॒साच्च॒ नि मर्त्या॑दघा॒योः । पा॒हि सद॒मिद्वि॒श्वायुः॑ ॥
items.pada_patha: सः । नः॒ । दू॒रात् । च॒ । आ॒सात् । च॒ । नि । मर्त्या॑त् । अ॒घ॒ऽयोः । पा॒हि । सद॑म् । इत् । वि॒श्वऽआ॑युः ॥

commentaries.griffith: Lord of all life, from near; from far, do thou, O Agni evermore Protect us from the sinful man.
commentaries.oldenberg: Thus protect us always, thou who hast a full life, from the mortal who seeks to do us harm 1, whether near or afar.
commentaries.geldner: Schütze du uns fern und nah vor dem böswilligen Sterblichen, immerdar, lebenslänglich!
commentaries.grassmann: Du schütze uns von nah und fern vor frevelhaftem Sterblichen, Du Allbeleber immerdar.
commentaries.elizarenkova: (Ты) нас издали и изблизи / От злоумышляющего смертного / Защищай всегда, весь срок (нашей) жизни!

items.samhita_patha_plain: स नो दूराच्चासाच्च नि मर्त्यादघायोः । पाहि सदमिद्विश्वायुः ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: सः । नः । दूरात् । च । आसात् । च । नि । मर्त्यात् । अघऽयोः । पाहि । सदम् । इत् । विश्वऽआयुः ॥

items.samhita_patha: इ॒ममू॒ षु त्वम॒स्माकं॑ स॒निं गा॑य॒त्रं नव्यां॑सम् । अग्ने॑ दे॒वेषु॒ प्र वो॑चः ॥
items.pada_patha: इ॒मम् । ऊँ॒ इति॑ । सु । त्वम् । अ॒स्माक॑म् । स॒निम् । गा॒य॒त्रम् । नव्यां॑सम् । अग्ने॑ । दे॒वेषु॑ । प्र । वो॒चः॒ ॥

commentaries.griffith: O Agni, graciously announce this our oblation to the Gods, And this our newest song of praise.
commentaries.oldenberg: And mayest thou, O Agni, announce to the gods this our newest efficient Gâyatra song.
commentaries.geldner: Diese unsere neueste Gabe, das Gesangeslied, melde du, Agni, fein den Göttern!
commentaries.grassmann: Und künde unsre Spende schön und diesen neusten Lobgesang, o Agni, du den Göttern an.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Эту вот прекрасную нашу заслугу – / Новый гимн размером Гаятри / Ты, Агни, провозгласи среди-богов!

items.samhita_patha_plain: इममू षु त्वमस्माकं सनिं गायत्रं नव्यांसम् । अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: इमम् । ऊँ इति । सु । त्वम् । अस्माकम् । सनिम् । गायत्रम् । नव्यांसम् । अग्ने । देवेषु । प्र । वोचः ॥

items.samhita_patha: आ नो॑ भज पर॒मेष्वा वाजे॑षु मध्य॒मेषु॑ । शिक्षा॒ वस्वो॒ अन्त॑मस्य ॥
items.pada_patha: आ । नः॑ । भ॒ज॒ । प॒र॒मेषु॑ । आ । वाजे॑षु । म॒ध्य॒मेषु॑ । शिक्षा॑ । वस्वः॑ । अन्त॑मस्य ॥

commentaries.griffith: Give us a share of strength most high, a share of strength that is below, A share of strength that is between.
commentaries.oldenberg: Let us partake of all booty that is highest and that is middle (i. e. that dwells in the highest and in the middle world); help us to the wealth that is nearest.
commentaries.geldner: Gib uns Anteil an den höchsten Siegerpreisen, an den mittleren, bemühe dich um das nächste Gut!
commentaries.grassmann: Die höchsten Gaben theil uns zu und theil uns zu die mittleren, Beschenk uns mit dem nächsten Gut.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Надели нас высшими (наградами), / На (дели) средними наградами! / Позаботься о ближайшем имуществе!

items.samhita_patha_plain: आ नो भज परमेष्वा वाजेषु मध्यमेषु । शिक्षा वस्वो अन्तमस्य ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: आ । नः । भज । परमेषु । आ । वाजेषु । मध्यमेषु । शिक्षा । वस्वः । अन्तमस्य ॥

items.samhita_patha: वि॒भ॒क्तासि॑ चित्रभानो॒ सिन्धो॑रू॒र्मा उ॑पा॒क आ । स॒द्यो दा॒शुषे॑ क्षरसि ॥
items.pada_patha: वि॒ऽभ॒क्ता । अ॒सि॒ । चि॒त्र॒भा॒नो॒ इति॑ चित्रऽभानो । सिन्धोः॑ । ऊ॒र्मौ । उ॒पा॒के । आ । स॒द्यः । दा॒शुषे॑ । क्ष॒र॒सि॒ ॥

commentaries.griffith: Thou dealest gifts, resplendent One; nigh, as with waves of Sindhu, thou Swift streamest to the worshipper.
commentaries.oldenberg: O god with bright splendour, thou art the distributor. Thou instantly flowest for the liberal giver in the wave of the river, near at hand.
commentaries.geldner: Du bist der Verteiler, du Buntglänzender. Wie auf der Sindhu Woge strömest du alsbald in nächste Nähe dem Spender zu.
commentaries.grassmann: Vertheiler bist du, strahlender, in Stromes Wogen fliessest du Sogleich dem Frommen nah herbei.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты – распределитель (благ), о яркопламенный. / (Как) на волне Синдху (принесенный) совсем близко, / Ты изливаешь вдруг (блага) почитающему (тебя).

items.samhita_patha_plain: विभक्तासि चित्रभानो सिन्धोरूर्मा उपाक आ । सद्यो दाशुषे क्षरसि ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: विऽभक्ता । असि । चित्रभानो इति चित्रऽभानो । सिन्धोः । ऊर्मौ । उपाके । आ । सद्यः । दाशुषे । क्षरसि ॥

items.samhita_patha: यम॑ग्ने पृ॒त्सु मर्त्य॒मवा॒ वाजे॑षु॒ यं जु॒नाः । स यन्ता॒ शश्व॑ती॒रिषः॑ ॥
items.pada_patha: यम् । अ॒ग्ने॒ । पृ॒त्ऽसु । मर्त्य॑म् । अवाः॑ । वाजे॑षु । यम् । जु॒नाः । सः । यन्ता॑ । शश्व॑तीः । इषः॑ ॥

commentaries.griffith: That man is lord of endless strength whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, or urgest to the fray.
commentaries.oldenberg: The mortal, O Agni, whom thou protectest in battles, whom thou speedest in the races 1, he will command constant nourishment:
commentaries.geldner: Welchen Sterblichen du, Agni, in den Schlachten begünstigen wirst, wen du in den Kämpfen um die Preise anspornst, der wird alle Genüsse in der Hand halten.
commentaries.grassmann: Der Sterbliche, den, Agni, du in Schlachten schützest und beeilst, Erlanget stete Labungen.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Какого смертного, о Агни, в сражениях / Ты поддержишь, кого поторопишь к наградам, / Тот удержит непрерывные подкрепления.

items.samhita_patha_plain: यमग्ने पृत्सु मर्त्यमवा वाजेषु यं जुनाः । स यन्ता शश्वतीरिषः ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: यम् । अग्ने । पृत्ऽसु । मर्त्यम् । अवाः । वाजेषु । यम् । जुनाः । सः । यन्ता । शश्वतीः । इषः ॥

items.samhita_patha: नकि॑रस्य सहन्त्य पर्ये॒ता कय॑स्य चित् । वाजो॑ अस्ति श्र॒वाय्यः॑ ॥
items.pada_patha: नकिः॑ । अ॒स्य॒ । स॒ह॒न्त्य॒ । प॒रि॒ऽए॒ता । कय॑स्य । चि॒त् । वाजः॑ । अ॒स्ति॒ । श्र॒वाय्यः॑ ॥

commentaries.griffith: Him, whosoever he may be, no man may vanquish, mighty One: Nay, very glorious power is his.
commentaries.oldenberg: Whosoever he may be, no one will overtake him, O conqueror (Agni)! His strength 2 is glorious.
commentaries.geldner: Keiner überholt ihn, wer er auch sei, o Gewaltiger. Ruhmbringender Gewinn ist sein.
commentaries.grassmann: Wer er auch sei, o mächtiger, den überwältigt keiner je, Und rühmenswerth ist seine Kraft.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Никто не возьмет верх над ним, / Кем бы он ни был, о одолевающий! / Награда, достойная славы, – (его доля).

items.samhita_patha_plain: नकिरस्य सहन्त्य पर्येता कयस्य चित् । वाजो अस्ति श्रवाय्यः ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: नकिः । अस्य । सहन्त्य । परिऽएता । कयस्य । चित् । वाजः । अस्ति । श्रवाय्यः ॥

items.samhita_patha: स वाजं॑ वि॒श्वच॑र्षणि॒रर्व॑द्भिरस्तु॒ तरु॑ता । विप्रे॑भिरस्तु॒ सनि॑ता ॥
items.pada_patha: सः । वाज॑म् । वि॒श्वऽच॑र्षणिः । अर्व॑त्ऽभिः । अ॒स्तु॒ । तरु॑ता । विप्रे॑भिः । अ॒स्तु॒ । सनि॑ता ॥

commentaries.griffith: May he who dwells with all mankind bear us with war-steeds through the fight, And with the singers win the spoil.
commentaries.oldenberg: May he (the man), known among all tribes 3, Win the race with his horses; may he with the help of his priests become a gainer.
commentaries.geldner: Er soll, in allen Landen bekannt, mit seinen Rennpferden den Siegerpreis erringen, durch seine Wortführer soll er den Preis gewinnen.
commentaries.grassmann: Der mög', in aller Welt berühmt, den Preis erringen sich zu Ross, Gewinnen mit der Sänger Schar.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Да будет он, принадлежащий всем народам, / Завоевателем награды с помощью (своих) скакунов! / Да будет он завоевателем награды с помощью вдохновенных (поэтов)!

items.samhita_patha_plain: स वाजं विश्वचर्षणिरर्वद्भिरस्तु तरुता । विप्रेभिरस्तु सनिता ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: सः । वाजम् । विश्वऽचर्षणिः । अर्वत्ऽभिः । अस्तु । तरुता । विप्रेभिः । अस्तु । सनिता ॥

items.samhita_patha: जरा॑बोध॒ तद्वि॑विड्ढि वि॒शेवि॑शे य॒ज्ञिया॑य । स्तोमं॑ रु॒द्राय॒ दृशी॑कम् ॥
items.pada_patha: जरा॑ऽबोध । तत् । वि॒वि॒ड्ढि॒ । वि॒शेऽवि॑शे । य॒ज्ञिया॑य । स्तोम॑म् । रु॒द्राय॑ । दृशी॑कम् ॥

commentaries.griffith: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, this eulogy to Rudra, him Adorable in every house.
commentaries.oldenberg: O Garabodha 1! Accomplish this (task) for every house 2: a beautiful song of praise for worshipful Rudra 3.
commentaries.geldner: Du Frühwacher, bring das zustande: ein schönes Loblied auf Rudra, der für jeden Clan verehrungswürdig ist!
commentaries.grassmann: Sangkundiger, so stimme an, dem glänzenden, der jedem Stamm Zu ehren ist, ein schönes Lied.
commentaries.elizarenkova: О бодрствующий при пробуждении (Агни), сложи это: / Восхваление, прекрасное на вид, для блистающего (Агни), / Достойного жертв у всех племен.

items.samhita_patha_plain: जराबोध तद्विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय । स्तोमं रुद्राय दृशीकम् ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: जराऽबोध । तत् । विविड्ढि । विशेऽविशे । यज्ञियाय । स्तोमम् । रुद्राय । दृशीकम् ॥

items.samhita_patha: स नो॑ म॒हाँ अ॑निमा॒नो धू॒मके॑तुः पुरुश्च॒न्द्रः । धि॒ये वाजा॑य हिन्वतु ॥

commentaries.griffith: May this our God, great, limitless, smoke-bannered excellently bright, Urge us to strength and holy thought.
commentaries.oldenberg: May he, the great, the immeasurable, the smoke-bannered, rich in splendour, incite us to (pious) thoughts and to strength.
commentaries.geldner: Er, der Große ohnegleichen, mit dem Rauch als Banner, der Glanzreiche soll uns zu frommem Gedanken und Sieg anspornen.
commentaries.grassmann: Er, welcher unermessen gross, sehr hell des Rauches Fahne schwingt, Zu Kraft und Einsicht führ' er uns.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Он, великий, безграничный, / С дымом-знаменем, многояркий, / Пусть подгонит нас к вдохновению, к награде!

items.samhita_patha_plain: स नो महाँ अनिमानो धूमकेतुः पुरुश्चन्द्रः । धिये वाजाय हिन्वतु ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: सः । नः । महान् । अनिऽमानः । धूमऽकेतुः । पुरुऽचन्द्रः । धिये । वाजाय । हिन्वतु ॥

items.samhita_patha: स रे॒वाँइ॑व वि॒श्पति॒र्दैव्यः॑ के॒तुः शृ॑णोतु नः । उ॒क्थैर॒ग्निर्बृ॒हद्भा॑नुः ॥

commentaries.griffith: Like some rich Lord of men may he, Agni the banner of the Gods, Refulgent, hear us through our lauds.
commentaries.oldenberg: May he hear us, like the rich lord of a clan, the banner of the gods, on behalf of our hymns, Agni with bright light.
commentaries.geldner: Er soll wie ein reicher Clanherr auf uns hören, das göttliche Banner, Agni, der bei unseren Lobliedern hell erglänzt.
commentaries.grassmann: Als reicher Stammfürst höre er, der Götter hohes Banner, uns, Agni, der hell durch Spruch erglänzt.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Он, как богатый глава рода, / Божественное знамя, пусть слушает нас / С (нашими) песнями – Агни с высокими лучами!

items.samhita_patha_plain: स रेवाँइव विश्पतिर्दैव्यः केतुः शृणोतु नः । उक्थैरग्निर्बृहद्भानुः ॥

commentaries.griffith: Glory to Gods, the mighty and the lesser glory to Gods the younger and the elder! Let us, if we have power, pay the God worship: no better prayer than this, ye Gods, acknowledge.
commentaries.oldenberg: Reverence to the great ones, reverence to the lesser ones! Reverence to the young, reverence to the old 1! I Let us sacrifice to the gods, if we can. May I not, O gods, fall as a victim to the curse of my better 2.
commentaries.geldner: Verneigung vor den Großen, Verneigung vor den Kleinen, Verneigung vor den Jungen, Verneigung vor den Betagten! Wir wollen die Götter verehren, wenn wir es vermögen. Nicht möchte ich die Rede eines Höheren vorwegnehmen, ihr Götter.
commentaries.grassmann: Anbetung sei den grossen, Anbetung den kleinen, Anbetung den jungen, Anbetung den alten; wir wollen die Götter verehren, so gut wir es vermögen; nicht möchte ich zurückbleiben hinter dem Preise eines angeseheneren.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Поклон великим, поклон малым, / Поклон юным, поклон достигшим (старости)! / Мы хотим почитать богов, если мы сумеем! / Да не помешаю я речи лучшего (певца), о боги!

commentaries.griffith: THERE where the broad-based stone raised on high to press the juices out, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.
commentaries.geldner: Wo der Stein mit breitem Fuß zum Ausschlagen aufgerichtet wird, da mögest du Indra den im Mörser ausgeschlagenen Soma hinunterschlingen.
commentaries.grassmann: Dort, wo der Stein mit breitem Fuss zum Somapressen sich erhebt, Da schlinge, Indra, du hinab den Saft, den dir der Mörser presst.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Где давильный камень с широкой основой / Высоко поднят для выжимания, / Глотай же (там), о Индра, / Соки, выжатые в ступке!

items.samhita_patha_plain: यत्र ग्रावा पृथुबुध्न ऊर्ध्वो भवति सोतवे । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥

commentaries.griffith: Where, like broad hips, to hold the juice the platters of the press are laid, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.
commentaries.geldner: Wo die beiden Preßbretter wie zwei Schamteile geformt sind, da mögest du Indra den im Mörser ausgeschlagenen Soma hinunterschlingen.
commentaries.grassmann: Dort, wo der Presse Platten wie zwei Hüften zubereitet sind, Da schlinge, Indra, du hinab den Saft, den dir der Mörser presst.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Где две доски для выжимания / Сделаны, как чресла, / Заглатывай же (там), о Индра, / Соки, выжатые в ступке!

commentaries.griffith: There where the woman marks and leans the pestle's constant rise and fall, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.
commentaries.geldner: Wo die Frau das Hinstoßen und Herstoßen einübt, da mögest du Indra den im Mörser ausgeschlagenen Soma hinunterschlingen.
commentaries.grassmann: Wo das Weib das heftige Entfernen und Herandringen kennen lernt, da schlinge, Indra, du hinab den Saft, den dir der Mörser presst.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Где женщина занимается / Выталкиванием-вталкиванием, / Заглатывай же (там), о Индра, / Соки, выжатые в ступке!

commentaries.griffith: Where, as with reins to guide a horse, they bind the churning-staff with cords, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.
commentaries.geldner: Wo sie den Stößel festbinden wie Zügel zum Lenken, da mögest du Indra den im Mörser ausgeschlagenen Soma hinunterschlingen.
commentaries.grassmann: Dort, wo den Quirl man rings umfasst, wie Zügel, wenn man Rosse lenkt, Da schlinge, Indra, du hinab den Saft, den dir der Mörser presst.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Где привязывают пестик, / Как поводья, чтобы править, / Заглатывай же (там), о Индра, / Соки, выжатые в ступке!

commentaries.griffith: If of a truth in every house, O Mortar thou art set for work, Here give thou forth thy clearest sound, loud as the drum of conquerors.
commentaries.geldner: Wenngleich du Mörserchen in jedem Hause angespannt wirst, so erklinge hier am hellsten wie die Pauke der Sieger!
commentaries.grassmann: Wenn du in jedem Hause auch, o Mörserchen, wirst angeschirrt, So töne doch am hellsten hier, gleichwie der Sieger Paukenschlag.
commentaries.elizarenkova: А когда уж тебя, ступочка, / В каждом доме впрягают, / Здесь звучи громче всего, / Как барабан у победителей!

items.samhita_patha_plain: यच्चिद्धि त्वं गृहेगृह उलूखलक युज्यसे । इह द्युमत्तमं वद जयतामिव दुन्दुभिः ॥

commentaries.griffith: O Sovran of the Forest, as the wind blows soft in front of thee, Mortar, for Indra press thou forth the Soma juice that he may drink.
commentaries.geldner: Und um deine Spitze, o Holz, wehte der Wind. Nun schlag den Soma für Indra zum Trinken aus, du Mörser!
commentaries.grassmann: Und dir, o Mörserkeule, weht der Wind vor deinem Angesicht; Dem Indra presse nun zum Trunk den Soma aus, o Mörser du.
commentaries.elizarenkova: А самую твою верхушку, / О дерево, ветер обвевает. / Так выжимай же сому, ступка, / Индре для питья!

commentaries.griffith: Best strength-givers, ye stretch wide jaws, O Sacrificial Implements, Like two bay horses champing herbs.
commentaries.geldner: Bittopfer vollziehend, vielen Gewinn einbringend, sperren ja beide den Rachen nach oben auf, die Somapflanzen schlampfend wie Indra´s Falben.
commentaries.grassmann: Die opfernd reichlich Kraft verleihn, sie sperren weit den Rachen auf, Wie Rosse, welche Kräuter kaun.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Приобретающие жертвой, добывающие самую большую награду, / Эти двое громко мечутся туда-сюда, / Пожирая растения сомы, подобно паре буланых коней (Индры).

commentaries.griffith: Ye Sovrans of the Forest, both swift, with swift pressers press to-day Sweet Soma juice for Indra's drink.
commentaries.geldner: Ihr zwei Hölzer, presset uns heute aufgerichtet mit den aufgerichteten Auspressern den süßen Saft für Indra aus!
commentaries.grassmann: Ihr Bretter, presset beide heut dem Indra süssen Somasaft, Durch hohe Presser ihr erhöht.
commentaries.elizarenkova: О вы, два дерева, сегодня, / Высокие с высокими (жрецами-) выжимателями, / Выжимайте сладкий (сок) для Индры!

commentaries.griffith: Take up in beakers what remains: the Soma on the filter pour, and on the ox-hide set the dregs.
commentaries.geldner: Nimm den Rest in der Somapresse heraus, schütte den Soma auf die Seihe, leg den Rest auf die Rindshaut nieder!
commentaries.grassmann: Nimm, was noch in den Schalen bleibt, den Soma giesse auf das Sieb, Und bring ihn in den Lederschlauch.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Вынь остаток из выжималки, / Пропусти сому через цедилку / Положи (остаток) на коровью шкуру!

items.samhita_patha_plain: उच्छिष्टं चम्वोर्भर सोमं पवित्र आ सृज । नि धेहि गोरधि त्वचि ॥

commentaries.griffith: O SOMA DRINKER, ever true, utterly hopeless though we be, Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
commentaries.geldner: Wenn wir auch wie Hoffnungslose sind, du bewährter Somatrinker, so mach uns doch Hoffnung auf tausend schmucke Kühe und Rosse, o freigebiger Indra!
commentaries.grassmann: Wenn, wahrer Somatrinker, wir auch sind wie ungepriesene, Du, Indra, mach uns herrlich doch an Rindern, Rossen, glänzenden, an tausenden, sehr reicher du.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Если уж так (случилось), о истинный, о пьющий сому, / (Что) мы живем, словно без надежды, / Дай же нам, о Индра, надежду / (В виде) коров, коней, тысячи прекрасных (благ), о (ты,) очень богатый!

commentaries.griffith: O Lord of Strength, whose jaws are strong, great deeds are thine, the powerful: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
commentaries.geldner: Du lippenöffnender Meister der Gewinne, du Kraftbegabter, du hast ja die Machtvollkommenheit; mach uns doch Hoffnung auf tausend schmucke Kühe und Rosse, o freigebiger Indra!
commentaries.grassmann: O schöner Herr der Labungen, dein ist, o starker, Wunderkraft, Du, Indra, mach uns herrlich doch an Rindern, Rossen, glänzenden, an tausenden, sehr reicher du.
commentaries.elizarenkova: О прекрасногубый, господин наград, / Могучий, у тебя – чудесная сила. / Дай же нам, о Индра, надежду / (В виде) коров, коней, тысячи прекрасных (благ), о (ты,) очень богатый!

commentaries.griffith: Lull thou asleep, to wake no more, the pair who on each other look Do thou, O Indra, give us, help of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
commentaries.geldner: Schläfere die beiden verschieden Aussehenden ein; ohne zu erwachen sollen beide schlafen. Mach uns doch Hoffnung auf tausend schmucke Kühe und Rosse, o freigebiger Indra!
commentaries.grassmann: Die wechselnd wachen, schläfre ein, lass schlafen, nie erwachen sie, Du, Indra, mach uns herrlich doch an Rindern, Rossen, glänzenden, an tausenden, sehr reicher du.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Усыпи тех двух с обманчивым взглядом! / Пусть спят они беспробудно! / Дай же нам, о Индра, надежду / (В виде) коров, коней, тысячи прекрасных (благ), о (ты,) очень богатый!

commentaries.griffith: Hero, let hostile spirits sleep, and every gentler genius wake: Do thou, O Indra,. give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
commentaries.geldner: Schlafen sollen jene Unholdinnen, wachen sollen die Huldinnen, du Held. Mach uns doch Hoffnung auf tausend schmucke Kühe und Rosse, o freigebiger Indra!
commentaries.grassmann: Lass schlafen alle geizigen, lass wachen Held die gebenden, Du, Indra, mach uns herrlich doch an Rindern, Rossen, glänzenden, an tausenden, sehr reicher du.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Пусть заснут те недоброжелатели! / Пусть бодрствуют, о герой, доброжелатели! / Дай же нам, о Индра, надежду / (В виде) коров, коней, тысячи прекрасных (благ), о (ты,) очень богатый!

commentaries.griffith: Destroy this ass, O Indra, who in tones discordant brays to thee: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
commentaries.geldner: Zerdrisch den Esel, Indra, der gar so übel schreit ! Mach uns doch Hoffnung auf tausend schmucke Kühe und Rosse, o freigebiger Indra!
commentaries.grassmann: Den Esel, Indra, schlage todt, der auf so üble Weise brüllt, Du, Indra, mach uns herrlich doch an Rindern, Rossen, glänzenden, an tausenden, sehr reicher du.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Сокруши, о Индра, осла, / Так гадко ревущего! / Дай же нам, о Индра, надежду / (В виде) коров, коней, тысячи прекрасных (благ), о (ты,) очень богатый!

commentaries.griffith: Far distant on the forest fall the tempest in a circling course! Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
commentaries.geldner: Mit der Kundrinaci fliege der Wind weit weg vom Baum. Mach uns doch Hoffnung auf tausend schmucke Kühe und Rosse, o freigebiger Indra!
commentaries.grassmann: Weit treibe über Wälder weg der Wind den Aar, der uns umkreist, Du, Indra, mach uns herrlich doch an Rindern, Rossen, glänzenden, an tausenden, sehr reicher du.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Пусть улетит со зловещей птицей / Далеко от дерева ветер! / Дай же нам, о Индра, надежду / (В виде) коров, копей, тысячи прекрасных (благ), о (ты) очень богатый!

items.samhita_patha_plain: पताति कुण्डृणाच्या दूरं वातो वनादधि । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥

commentaries.griffith: Slay each reviler, and destroy him who in secret injures us: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine In thousands, O most wealthy One.
commentaries.geldner: Erschlag jeden Beschreier, erwürge den Krikadasu. Mach uns doch Hoffnung auf tausend schmucke Kühe und Rosse, o freigebiger Indra!
commentaries.grassmann: Erschlage jeden, welcher schmäht, zermalm den Dämon, welcher kreischt, Du, Indra, mach uns herrlich doch an Rindern, Rossen, glänzenden, an tausenden, sehr reicher du.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Убей всякого крикуна! / Загрызи Крикадашу! / Дай же нам, о Индра, надежду / (В виде) коров, коней, тысячи прекрасных (благ), о (ты,) очень богатый!

commentaries.griffith: WE seeking strength with Soma-drops fill full your Indra like a well, Most liberal, Lord of Hundred Powers,
commentaries.geldner: Indem wir euren ratreichen Indra wie einen Falben anspornen, begieße ich den Freigebigsten mit Somagüssen.
commentaries.grassmann: Wie Labungsreiche einen Schlauch, netz' euren mächt'gen Indra ich, Mit Indu's ihn, der reichlich schenkt.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Когда для вас Индру, как рыжего (жеребца) / Мы подгоняем, стоумного, / Я поливаю самого щедрого соками сомы.

commentaries.griffith: Who lets a hundred of the pure, a thousand of the milk-blent draughts Flow, even as down a depth, to him;
commentaries.geldner: Der hundert Spenden des reinen oder tausend des milchgemischten Soma trinkt. Er rinnt wie Wasser in die Tiefe.
commentaries.grassmann: Der hundert- oder tausendfach das Milchgebräu in sich hinein Wie in die Tiefe strömen lässt.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Кто – или сто чистых (струй), / Или тысяча смешанных с молоком, / (Тот) стекает, как (река), в низину.

commentaries.griffith: When for the strong, the rapturous joy he in this manner hath made room Within his belly, like the sea.
commentaries.geldner: Wenn sie zu heftigem Rausche zusammenströmen, so bekommt er ja dadurch in seinem Bauch einen Umfang wie das Meer.
commentaries.grassmann: Wenn sie zusammenströmen dann in seinen Bauch zu kräft'gen Rausch, Dann wird sein Umfang wie ein Meer.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Когда эти (соки) с(ливаются) / Для мощного опьянения у него в животе, / (Индра) становится широким, как океан.

items.samhita_patha_plain: सं यन्मदाय शुष्मिण एना ह्यस्योदरे । समुद्रो न व्यचो दधे ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: सम् । यत् । मदाय । शुष्मिणे । एना । हि । अस्य । उदरे । समुद्रः । न । व्यचः । दधे ॥

items.samhita_patha: अ॒यमु॑ ते॒ सम॑तसि क॒पोत॑इव गर्भ॒धिम् । वच॒स्तच्चि॑न्न ओहसे ॥
items.pada_patha: अ॒यम् । ऊँम् इति॑ । ते॒ । सम् । अ॒त॒सि॒ । क॒पोतः॑ऽइव । ग॒र्भ॒ऽधिम् । वचः॑ । तत् । चि॒त् । नः॒ । ओ॒ह॒से॒ ॥

commentaries.griffith: This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest too for this our prayer.
commentaries.geldner: Dieser Soma ist dein. Du schießest darauf los wie der Täuberich auf sein Weibchen. Diese Rede von uns weißt du gewiß zu würdigen.
commentaries.grassmann: Hier steht der Trank, du gehst drauf los, gleich wie der Täubrich auf sein Nest; Beachte recht dies unser Wort.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Вот он твой. Ты кидаешься (к нему), / Как голубь – к гнезду. / Эту речь нашу ты, конечно, заметишь.

items.samhita_patha_plain: अयमु ते समतसि कपोतइव गर्भधिम् । वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: अयम् । ऊँम् इति । ते । सम् । अतसि । कपोतःऽइव । गर्भऽधिम् । वचः । तत् । चित् । नः । ओहसे ॥

items.samhita_patha: स्तो॒त्रं रा॑धानां पते॒ गिर्वा॑हो वीर॒ यस्य॑ ते । विभू॑तिरस्तु सू॒नृता॑ ॥

commentaries.griffith: O Hero, Lord of Bounties, praised in hymns, may power and joyfulness Be his who sings the laud to thee.
commentaries.geldner: Du Held, für den das Preislied ist, du Herr der Gaben, für den die Lobrede eine Anziehung ist, deine Großmut soll ausgiebig sein.
commentaries.grassmann: Wer dir, o liedumtönter Held, o Herr der Schätze, Lieder singt, Dem werde hohes Glück zu Theil.
commentaries.elizarenkova: (О ты,) кому восхваление, о господин дарений, / О герой, взнуздывающий хвалебную песнь, / Да будет обширным твое благоволение!

items.samhita_patha_plain: स्तोत्रं राधानां पते गिर्वाहो वीर यस्य ते । विभूतिरस्तु सूनृता ॥

items.samhita_patha: ऊ॒र्ध्वस्ति॑ष्ठा न ऊ॒तये॒ऽस्मिन्वाजे॑ शतक्रतो । सम॒न्येषु॑ ब्रवावहै ॥
items.pada_patha: ऊ॒र्ध्वः । ति॒ष्ठ॒ । नः॒ । ऊ॒तये॑ । अ॒स्मिन् । वाजे॑ । श॒त॒क्र॒तो॒ इति॑ शतऽक्रतो । सम् । अ॒न्येषु॑ । ब्र॒वा॒व॒है॒ ॥

commentaries.griffith: Lord of a Hundred Powers, stand up to lend us succour in this fight In others too let us agree.
commentaries.geldner: Steh aufrecht uns zum Beistand bei diesem Entscheidungskampf, du Ratreicher ! Über die andern wollen wir beide uns noch verständigen.
commentaries.grassmann: Erhebe dich zu unserm Schutz in dieser Schlacht, vielwirkender, In andern auch gesell dich mir.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Стой прямо нам для помощи / В состязании за эту награду, о стоумный! / Мы хотим сговориться (и) об остальных!

items.samhita_patha_plain: ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा न ऊतयेऽस्मिन्वाजे शतक्रतो । समन्येषु ब्रवावहै ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: ऊर्ध्वः । तिष्ठ । नः । ऊतये । अस्मिन् । वाजे । शतक्रतो इति शतऽक्रतो । सम् । अन्येषु । ब्रवावहै ॥

items.samhita_patha: योगे॑योगे त॒वस्त॑रं॒ वाजे॑वाजे हवामहे । सखा॑य॒ इन्द्र॑मू॒तये॑ ॥
items.pada_patha: योगे॑ऽयोगे । त॒वःऽत॑रम् । वाजे॑ऽवाजे । ह॒वा॒म॒हे॒ । सखा॑यः । इन्द्र॑म् । ऊ॒तये॑ ॥

commentaries.griffith: In every need, in every fray we call as friends to succour us Indra the mightiest of all.
commentaries.geldner: Indra, der bei jedem Unternehmen der Stärkere ist, bei jedem Entscheidungskampf, ihn rufen wir Genossen zum Beistand.
commentaries.grassmann: In jeder Arbeit, jedem Kampf, o Freunde, rufen Indra wir, Den kräftigsten zur Hülfe her.
commentaries.elizarenkova: В каждом деле все более сильного, в каждом (состязании) за награду, / Индру мы призываем / Как друзья – на помощь.

items.samhita_patha_plain: योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: योगेऽयोगे । तवःऽतरम् । वाजेऽवाजे । हवामहे । सखायः । इन्द्रम् । ऊतये ॥

items.samhita_patha: आ घा॑ गम॒द्यदि॒ श्रव॑त्सह॒स्रिणी॑भिरू॒तिभिः॑ । वाजे॑भि॒रुप॑ नो॒ हव॑म् ॥
items.pada_patha: आ । घ॒ । ग॒म॒त् । यदि॑ । श्रव॑त् । स॒ह॒स्रिणी॑भिः । ऊ॒तिऽभिः॑ । वाजे॑भिः । उप॑ । नः॒ । हव॑म् ॥

commentaries.griffith: If he will hear us let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, And all that strengthens, to our call.
commentaries.geldner: Er komme doch, wenn er es hört, mit seinen tausendfältigen Hilfen, mit den Siegergewinnen auf unseren Ruf.
commentaries.grassmann: Er komme, wenn er auf uns hört, mit tausendfachen Hülfen her, Mit Kräften her auf unsern Ruf.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Пусть же придет он, если услышит, / С поддержками тысячи родов, / С наградами на наш зов.

items.samhita_patha_plain: आ घा गमद्यदि श्रवत्सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिः । वाजेभिरुप नो हवम् ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: आ । घ । गमत् । यदि । श्रवत् । सहस्रिणीभिः । ऊतिऽभिः । वाजेभिः । उप । नः । हवम् ॥

items.samhita_patha: अनु॑ प्र॒त्नस्यौक॑सो हु॒वे तु॑विप्र॒तिं नर॑म् । यं ते॒ पूर्वं॑ पि॒ता हु॑वे ॥
items.pada_patha: अनु॑ । प्र॒त्नस्य॑ । ओक॑सः । हु॒वे । तु॒वि॒ऽप्र॒तिम् । नर॑म् । यम् । ते॒ । पूर्व॑म् । पि॒ता । हु॒वे ॥

commentaries.griffith: I call him mighty to resist, the Hero of our ancient home, Thee whom my sire invoked of old.
commentaries.geldner: Ich rufe nach alter Gewohnheit den Herrn, der viel aufwiegt, den früher dein Vater rief.
commentaries.grassmann: Dich Herrn der alten Heimat ruf' ich an, der vielen widersteht, Und den zuvor mein Vater rief.
commentaries.elizarenkova: По давней привычке / Зову я мужа, сильного сопротивлением, / Кого раньше звал твой отец.

items.samhita_patha_plain: अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसो हुवे तुविप्रतिं नरम् । यं ते पूर्वं पिता हुवे ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: अनु । प्रत्नस्य । ओकसः । हुवे । तुविऽप्रतिम् । नरम् । यम् । ते । पूर्वम् । पिता । हुवे ॥

items.samhita_patha: तं त्वा॑ व॒यं वि॑श्ववा॒रा शा॑स्महे पुरुहूत । सखे॑ वसो जरि॒तृभ्यः॑ ॥
items.pada_patha: तम् । त्वा॒ । व॒यम् । वि॒श्व॒ऽवा॒र॒ । आ । शा॒स्म॒हे॒ । पु॒रु॒ऽहू॒त॒ । सखे॑ । व॒सो॒ इति॑ । ज॒रि॒तृऽभ्यः॑ ॥

commentaries.griffith: We pray to thee, O much-invoked, rich in all prccious gifts, O Friend, Kind God to those who sing thy praise.
commentaries.geldner: Dich erbitten wir, du allbegehrter, vielgerufener, guter Genosse der Sänger;
commentaries.grassmann: Dich flehn wir, vielgerufener, an allen Gaben reicher, an, Den Sängern du ein holder Freund.
commentaries.elizarenkova: К тебе мы обращаемся, / О обладатель всего лучшего, о многопризываемый, / О друг, о Васу, – с нашими певцами.

items.samhita_patha_plain: तं त्वा वयं विश्ववारा शास्महे पुरुहूत । सखे वसो जरितृभ्यः ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: तम् । त्वा । वयम् । विश्वऽवार । आ । शास्महे । पुरुऽहूत । सखे । वसो इति । जरितृऽभ्यः ॥

items.samhita_patha: अ॒स्माकं॑ शि॒प्रिणी॑नां॒ सोम॑पाः सोम॒पाव्ना॑म् । सखे॑ वज्रि॒न्त्सखी॑नाम् ॥
items.pada_patha: अ॒स्माक॑म् । शि॒प्रिणी॑नाम् । सोम॑ऽपाः । सो॒म॒ऽपाव्ना॑म् । सखे॑ । व॒ज्रि॒न् । सखी॑नाम् ॥

commentaries.griffith: O Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed, Friend of our lovely-featured dames And of our Soma-drinking friends.
commentaries.geldner: Du Genosse von uns Genossen, den lippenöffnenden Somatrinkern, du Somatrinker, Keulenträger.
commentaries.grassmann: Du Freund der Freunde, blitzbewehrt, und unsrer schönen Frauen auch, der du mit Somatrinkern trinkst,
commentaries.elizarenkova: У нас, губастых, / Пьющий сому, у питухов сомы, / О друг, о громовержец, у друзей...

items.samhita_patha_plain: अस्माकं शिप्रिणीनां सोमपाः सोमपाव्नाम् । सखे वज्रिन्त्सखीनाम् ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: अस्माकम् । शिप्रिणीनाम् । सोमऽपाः । सोमऽपाव्नाम् । सखे । वज्रिन् । सखीनाम् ॥

items.samhita_patha: तथा॒ तद॑स्तु सोमपाः॒ सखे॑ वज्रि॒न्तथा॑ कृणु । यथा॑ त उ॒श्मसी॒ष्टये॑ ॥

commentaries.griffith: Thus, Soma-drinker, may it be; thus, Friend, who wieldest thunder, act To aid each wish as we desire.
commentaries.geldner: So soll es sein, du Somatrinker, Genosse und Keulenträger, so richte es ein, daß du rasch kommst, wie wir von dir wünschen!
commentaries.grassmann: So mög es, Somatrinker, sein so thu, o blitzbewehrter Freund, Wie wir's begehren, recht nach Wunsch.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Да сбудется это, о пьющий сому, / О друг, громовержец. Сделай так, / Как мы хотим от тебя: чтобы ты искал (добычу для нас)!

items.samhita_patha_plain: तथा तदस्तु सोमपाः सखे वज्रिन्तथा कृणु । यथा त उश्मसीष्टये ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: तथा । तत् । अस्तु । सोमऽपाः । सखे । वज्रिन् । तथा । कृणु । यथा । ते । उश्मसि । इष्टये ॥

items.samhita_patha: रे॒वती॑र्नः सध॒माद॒ इन्द्रे॑ सन्तु तु॒विवा॑जाः । क्षु॒मन्तो॒ याभि॒र्मदे॑म ॥
items.pada_patha: रे॒वतीः॑ । नः॒ । स॒ध॒ऽमादे॑ । इन्द्रे॑ । स॒न्तु॒ । तु॒विऽवा॑जाः । क्षु॒ऽमन्तः॑ । याभिः॑ । मदे॑म ॥

commentaries.griffith: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice.
commentaries.geldner: Reiche Geschenke sollen uns bei dem Mahlgenossen Indra werden, lohnvolle, an denen wir im Besitz von Vieh uns gütlich tun können.
commentaries.grassmann: Reich sei uns an Gut und Nahrung jedes Mahl, dem Indra beiwohnt, Das wir labungsreich geniessen.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Пусть будут нам для совместного пира / У Индры богатые (милости), сильные награды, / Обильные питанием, которым мы бы радовались!

items.samhita_patha_plain: रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः । क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: रेवतीः । नः । सधऽमादे । इन्द्रे । सन्तु । तुविऽवाजाः । क्षुऽमन्तः । याभिः । मदेम ॥

items.samhita_patha: आ घ॒ त्वावा॒न्त्मना॒प्तः स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ धृष्णविया॒नः । ऋ॒णोरक्षं॒ न च॒क्र्योः॑ ॥
items.pada_patha: आ । घ॒ । त्वाऽवा॑न् । त्मना॑ । आ॒प्तः । स्तो॒तृऽभ्यः॑ । धृ॒ष्णो॒ इति॑ । इ॒या॒नः । ऋ॒णोः । अक्ष॑म् । न । च॒क्र्योः॑ ॥

commentaries.griffith: Like thee, thyself, the singers' Friend, thou movest, as it were, besought, Bold One, the axle of the car.
commentaries.geldner: Wenn einer wie du, Mutiger, der den Sängern persönlich bekannt ist, darum gebeten wird, solltest du gleichsam die Achse in die Räder einfügen.
commentaries.grassmann: Du ja selbst ein Freund der Sänger, kühner, fügst wie in die Räder Ein die Achse, angeflehter,
commentaries.elizarenkova: Конечно, такой, как ты, о доступный сам по себе / Певцам, когда тебя просят, о храбрый, / Ты (исполняешь) желание, (подобно тому,) как ось вставляешь в два колеса!

items.samhita_patha_plain: आ घ त्वावान्त्मनाप्तः स्तोतृभ्यो धृष्णवियानः । ऋणोरक्षं न चक्र्योः ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: आ । घ । त्वाऽवान् । त्मना । आप्तः । स्तोतृऽभ्यः । धृष्णो इति । इयानः । ऋणोः । अक्षम् । न । चक्र्योः ॥

items.samhita_patha: आ यद्दुवः॑ शतक्रत॒वा कामं॑ जरितॄ॒णाम् । ऋ॒णोरक्षं॒ न शची॑भिः ॥
items.pada_patha: आ । यत् । दुवः॑ । श॒त॒क्र॒तो॒ इति॑ शतऽक्रतो । आ । काम॑म् । ज॒रि॒तॄ॒णाम् । ऋ॒णोः । अक्ष॑म् । न । शची॑भिः ॥

commentaries.griffith: That, Satakratu, thou to grace and please thy praisers, as it were, Stirrest the axle with thy strength.
commentaries.geldner: Indem du, Ratreicher, auf den Eifer, auf den Wunsch der Sänger eingehst, fügst du nach Kräften gleichsam die Achse in die Räder.
commentaries.grassmann: Wenn du Gaben, vielgewalt'ger kräftig in den Wunsch der Sänger, Wie ins Rad die Achse einfügst.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Когда же, о стоумный, (ты оказываешь) почтение - / Ты (исполняешь) желание певцов, / (Подобно тому,) как ты вставляешь (в два колеса) - из всех сил.

items.samhita_patha_plain: आ यद्दुवः शतक्रतवा कामं जरितॄणाम् । ऋणोरक्षं न शचीभिः ॥
items.pada_patha_plain: आ । यत् । दुवः । शतक्रतो इति शतऽक्रतो । आ । कामम् । जरितॄणाम् । ऋणोः । अक्षम् । न । शचीभिः ॥

items.samhita_patha: शश्व॒दिन्द्रः॒ पोप्रु॑थद्भिर्जिगाय॒ नान॑दद्भिः॒ शाश्व॑सद्भि॒र्धना॑नि । स नो॑ हिरण्यर॒थं दं॒सना॑वा॒न्त्स नः॑ सनि॒ता स॒नये॒ स नो॑ऽदात् ॥

commentaries.griffith: With champing, neighing loudly-snorting horses Indra hath ever won himself great treasures A car of gold hath he whose deeds are wondrous received from us, and let us too receive it.
commentaries.geldner: Immer wieder hat Indra mit den prustenden, wiehernden, schnaubenden Rossen Reichtümer erobert. Der Meisterkünstler hat uns einen Wagen voll Gold geschenkt, er als unser Lohner zum Lohn, er hat ihn uns geschenkt.
commentaries.grassmann: Stets hat Indra mit den schnaubenden, tobenden, stark athmenden Rossen Schätze erbeutet; er hat uns, der wunderthätige, einen goldbeladenen Wagen gegeben, er, der schenkende, uns zum Geschenk gegeben.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Всегда завоевывал Индра со (своими) храпящими, / Ржущими, фыркающими (конями) богатства. / Он, обладатель чудесной силы, (дал) нам золотую колесницу / Он наш добытчик, чтоб добывали (мы), он нам дал.

commentaries.griffith: Come, Asvins, with enduring strength wealthy in horses and in kine, And gold, O ye of wondrous deeds.
commentaries.geldner: Ihr Asvin, kommt mit überlegenem Gut an Rossen ! Rinderbesitz, ihr Meister, Goldbesitz sei uns!
commentaries.grassmann: Mit rossereicher Labung kommt und starker, kräft'ge Ritter, her An Rindern und an Golde reich.
commentaries.elizarenkova: О Ашвины, с подкреплением в виде коней, / Преисполненным силы, приезжайте (на колеснице), / (Привозя) богатство из коров, богатство из золота, / О удивительные!

commentaries.griffith: Your chariot yoked for both alike, immortal, ye of mighty acts, Travels, O Aivins, in the sea.
commentaries.geldner: Denn euer unsterblicher Wagen fährt in einer Fahrt auf dem Meere, ihr Meister Asvin.
commentaries.grassmann: Denn euer ew'ger Wagen kommt der gleichgeschirrte durch die Luft, O wunderstarke Ritter ihr!
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ведь у вас двоих колесница, о удивительные, / С общей упряжью, бессмертная, / Едет по морю, о Ашвины!

commentaries.griffith: High on the forehead of the Bull one chariot wheel ye ever keep, The other round the sky revolves.
commentaries.geldner: Ihr hieltet das Rad des Wagens auf dem Haupte des Stiers an; das andere fährt um den Himmel.
commentaries.grassmann: Denn auf des Stiers, der Erde, Haupt lenkt ihr des Wagens eines Rad, Das andre läuft am Himmel um.
commentaries.elizarenkova: На голове быка / Вы удерживали колесо колесницы. / Другое катится вокруг неба.

items.samhita_patha_plain: न्य१घ्न्यस्य मूर्धनि चक्रं रथस्य येमथुः । परि द्यामन्यदीयते ॥

items.samhita_patha: कस्त॑ उषः कधप्रिये भु॒जे मर्तो॑ अमर्त्ये । कं न॑क्षसे विभावरि ॥

commentaries.griffith: What mortal, O immortal Dawn, enjoyeth thee? Where lovest thou? To whom, O radiant, dost thou go?
commentaries.geldner: Welcher Sterbliche soll deinen Genuß haben, unsterbliche, freundesuchende Usas? Zu wem kommst du Erglänzende?
commentaries.grassmann: Welch Sterblicher, Unsterbliche, ist lieb dir, Uschas, zum Genuss? Zu wem gehst hin du, strahlende?
commentaries.elizarenkova: О Ушас, о та, которой (неизвестно) как понравиться, / Какой смертный насладится тобой, о бессмертная? / К кому ты приближаешься, о озаряющая?

items.samhita_patha_plain: कस्त उषः कधप्रिये भुजे मर्तो अमर्त्ये । कं नक्षसे विभावरि ॥

commentaries.griffith: For we have had thee in our thoughts whether anear or far away, Red-hued and like a dappled mare.
commentaries.geldner: Denn wir haben nah und fern deiner gedacht, wie du eine Stute Prangende, Rötliche.
commentaries.grassmann: Denn in der Ferne, in der Näh gedenken dein wir, Morgenroth, Die du wie eine Stute strahlst.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ведь мы подумали о тебе / Изблизи (и) издалека, / О яркая, как пламенная кобылица!

items.samhita_patha_plain: वयं हि ते अमन्मह्यान्तादा पराकात् । अश्वे न चित्रे अरुषि ॥

items.samhita_patha: त्वं त्येभि॒रा ग॑हि॒ वाजे॑भिर्दुहितर्दिवः । अ॒स्मे र॒यिं नि धा॑रय ॥

commentaries.griffith: Hither, O Daughter of the Sky, come thou with these thy strengthenings, And send thou riches down to us.
commentaries.geldner: Komm du mit jenen Belohnungen her, Tochter des Himmels; hinterlaß bei uns den Reichtum!
commentaries.grassmann: O komm mit diesen Labungen, du Himmelstochter, zu uns her Und schenk uns Güter zum Besitz.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Приди ты с этими / Наградами, о дочь неба! / Оставь у нас богатство!

items.samhita_patha_plain: त्वं त्येभिरा गहि वाजेभिर्दुहितर्दिवः । अस्मे रयिं नि धारय ॥

commentaries.griffith: Thou, Agni, wast the earliest Angiras, a Seer; thou wast, a God thyself, the Gods' auspicious Friend. After thy holy ordinance the Maruts, sage, active through wisdom, -with their glittering spears, were born.
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, (who art) the first Angiras Rishi, hast become as god the kind friend of the gods. After thy law the sages, active in their wisdom 1, were born, the Maruts with brilliant spears.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni warst der erste Angiras und Rishi, du der Gott der Götter guter Freund. In deinem Dienste wurden die Seher, die mit Weisheit wirken, geboren, die Marut mit funkelnden Speeren.
commentaries.grassmann: Du, Agni, warst der erste Sänger Angiras, als Gott der Götter segnender Genosse du, In deinem Dienst entsprang der weisen Maruts Schar, die kunstvoll wirken, sie, die lanzenglänzenden.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты, о Агни, первый Ангирас, риши. / Ты стал богом – милым другом богов. / На службе у тебя поэты, действующие мудро, / Родились – Маруты со сверкающими копьями.

commentaries.griffith: O Agni, thou, the best and earliest Angiras, fulfillest as a Sage the holy law of Gods. Sprung from two mothers, wise, through all existence spread, resting in many a place for sake of living man.
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, the first, highest Angiras, a sage, administerest the law of the gods, mighty for the whole world, wise, the son of the two mothers 1, reposing everywhere for (the use of ) the living 2.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni, der erste, der oberste Angiras, wartest als Seher des Dienstes der Götter, für die ganze Welt hinreichend, weise, zweier Mütter Kind, in vielen liegend für Ayu.
commentaries.grassmann: Du, Agni, als der beste, erste Angiras, verwaltest als ein Seher stets der Götter Dienst; Für alle Wesen weise und gewaltig du, für Menschen allwärts ruhend, zweier Mütter Spross.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты, о Агни, первый, самый настоящий Ангирас, / Как поэт ты украшаешь обет богов, / Пронизывающий весь мир, мудрый, / (Сын) двух матерей, покоящийся так и сяк для Аю.

commentaries.griffith: To Matarisvan first thou, Agni, wast disclosed, and to Vivasvan through thy noble inward power. Heaven and Earth, Vasu! shook at the choosing of the Priest: the burthen thou didst bear, didst worship mighty Gods.
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, as the first, shalt become 1 manifest to Matarisvan, through thy high wisdom, to Vivasvat. The two worlds trembled at (thy) election as Hotri. Thou hast sustained the burthen; thou, O Vasu, hast sacrificed to the great (gods) 2.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni, werde zuerst dem Matarisvan offenbar, mit gutem Bedacht dem Vivasvat! Es bebten beide Welten bei der Hotri-Wahl, du warst der Bürde gewachsen, du opfertest den Großen, o Guter.
commentaries.grassmann: Du hast zuerst dem Matariçvan dich gezeigt, und dem Vivasvat, Agni, durch dein schönes Werk, Es bebten Erd' und Himmel bei des Priesters Wahl, du trugst die Last, die grossen ehrtest guter du.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты, о Агни, первым Матаришвану / Проявись прекрасной силою ума (и) Вивасвату! / Два мира сотрясались при выборе (Агни) хотаром: / Ты смог взвалить (на себя) это бремя. Ты почтил великих (богов), о Васу.

commentaries.griffith: Agni thou madest heaven to thunder for mankind; thou, yet more pious, for pious Pururavas. When thou art rapidly freed from thy parents, first eastward they bear thee round, and, after, to the west.
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, hast caused the sky to roar 1 for Manu, for the well-doing Purûravas, being thyself a greater well-doer. When thou art loosened by power (?) 2 from thy parents, they led thee hither before and afterwards again.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni brachtest für Manu den Himmel zum Brüllen, für deinen Wohltäter Pururavas ein noch größerer Wohltäter. Sobald du mit Kraft in den Eltern entbunden wardst, führten sie dich her, vorwärts und wieder zurück.
commentaries.grassmann: Den Himmel liessest donnern du dem Manuspross Pururavas, dem frommen du, der frommere; Wenn du durch Kraft von deinen Aeltern wirst gelöst, dann führt man bald nach Osten, bald nach Westen dich.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты, о Агни, для Ману заставил небо загрохотать, / Для Пурураваса-благодетеля – еще больший благодетель. / Когда силой роста ты освобождаешься от родителей, / Тебя стали отвозить на восток, (потом) снова на запад.

commentaries.griffith: Thou, Agni, art a Bull who makes our store increase, to be invoked by him who lifts the ladle up. Well knowing the oblation with the hallowing word, uniting all who live, thou lightenest first our folk
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, the bull, the augmenter of prosperity, art to be praised by the sacrificer who raises the Spoon, who knows all about the offering 1 and (the sacrifice performed with) the word Vashat. Thou (god) of unique vigour art the first to invite 2 the clans.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni bist ein Stier, der die Aufzucht mehrt, ruhmbringend wirst du dem, der den Opferlöffel hebt, der die Opferung, den Vasatruf genau kennt, der du im Anfang im Alleinbesitz des Ayu die Stämme zu gewinnen suchst.
commentaries.grassmann: Ein Stier bist du, o Agni, mehrst die Nahrung uns, bist anzurufen dem, der dir den Löffel reicht; Dem, der das Opfer kennet und den Opferruf, erfreust du, Herr der Menschen, alles Volk.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты о Агни, бык, увеличивающий процветание. / Ты бываешь достойным славы у поднимающего жертвенную ложку, / (Ты тот,) кто знает точно жертвенное возлияние (и) провозглашение Вашат! / (Бог,) принадлежащий одному Аю, с (самого) начала ты стремишься покорить племена.

commentaries.griffith: Agni, thou savest in the synod when pursued e'en him, farseeing One! who walks in evil ways. Thou, when the heroes fight for spoil which men rush, round, slayest in war the many by the hands of few.
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, leadest forward the man who follows crooked ways 1, in thy company at the sacrifice 2, O god dwelling among all tribes, who in the strife of heroes, in the decisive moment for the obtainment of the prize 3, even with few companions killest many foes in the battle 4.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni, hilfst dem in der Freundschaft, im Opfer auf krumme Wege geratenen Mann heraus, du ausgezeichneter, der du im Kampfe um den Tapferen, um den umstrittenen Siegerpreis, in der Schlacht selbst mit Wenigen die Überzahl schlägst.
commentaries.grassmann: Den Mann auch, Agni, der auf bösem Wege wallt, geleitest gnädig, weiser, du zum Opferfest, Der du im Streit der Helden, im Entscheidungskampf, mit wen'gen auch im Treffen schlägst die Ueberzahl.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты, о Агни, спасаешь мужа, следующего кривыми путями / В общении (с другими) в жертвенном собрании, о (ты,) очень подвижный, / (Ты,) что в решающей битве героев, (в борьбе) за богатство, / В столкновении даже с немногими побиваешь более многочисленных(врагов).

commentaries.griffith: For glory, Agni, day by day, thou liftest up the mortal man to highest immortality, Even thou who yearning for both races givest them great bliss, and to the prince grantest abundant food.
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, keepest that mortal 1 in the highest immortality, in glory day by day, (thou) who being thirsty thyself 2 givest happiness to both races (gods and men), and joy to the rich.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni bringst den Sterblichen zur höchsten Unsterblichkeit, zu Ruhm Tag für Tag, der du selbst durstig beiderlei Volk Erquickung schaffst und dem freigebigen Patron ein Labsal.
commentaries.grassmann: Du, Agni, führst den Menschen zur Unsterblichkeit zur höchsten, schaffest grossen Ruhm ihm Tag für Tag, Der du begierig Göttern und dem Menschenstamm Vergnügen schaffst und auch dem Fürsten Huld gewährst.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты, о Агни, смертного переносишь / В высшее бессмертие, в славу, (длящуюся) день за днем / (Ты,) который, сам (того) взыскуя, обоим родам / Даешь утешение и вознаграждение покровителю.

commentaries.griffith: O Agni, highly lauded, make our singer famous that he may win us store of riches: May we improve the rite with new performance. O Earth and Heaven, with all the Gods, protect us.
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, praised by us, help the glorious singer to gain prizes. May we accomplish our work with the help of the young active (Agni). O Heaven and Earth! Bless us together with the gods.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni mach, gepriesen, unseren Dichter geehrt, daß er Reichtümer gewinne! Möchte uns durch das neue Machwerk die Opferhandlung gelingen. Himmel und Erde, helfet uns mit den Göttern weiter!
commentaries.grassmann: O Agni, mache unsern Sänger herrlich, dass Schätze er gewinne, o gepriesner; Gelingen lass durch neuen Fleiss das Werk uns und mit den Göttern schützt uns, Erd' und Himmel!
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты, о Агни, прославленный, сделай нашего – / Певца уважаемым и чтобы он добыл богатства! / Пусть добьемся мы процветания обряда новым (жертвенным) трудом! / О Небо и Земля, помогайте нам вместе с богами!

commentaries.griffith: O blameless Agni lying in thy Parents' lap, a God among the Gods, be watchful for our good. Former of bodies, be the singer's Providence: all good things hast thou sown for him, auspicious One!
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, in the lap of thy parents, a god among gods, O blameless one, always watchful, be the body’s creator and guardian to the singer. Thou, O beautiful one, pourest forth all wealth.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni sei uns im Schoße der Eltern als Gott über die Götter wachend, du Untadeliger! Sei dem Dichter leiblicher Erzeuger und Vorsehung. Du Glückbringender hast alles Gute ausgeschüttet.
commentaries.grassmann: Sei wachsam uns, o Agni, in der Aeltern Schooss, und bei den Göttern, tadelloser, du als Gott, Bewahr des Dichters Leben, sei ihm hold gesinnt; du hast, o schöner, alles Gute ausgesät.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты для нас, о Агни, в лоне родителей – / Бог среди богов, о безупречный, бодрствующий. / Стань певцу родителем и заступничеством! / Ты, несущий счастье, посеял все доброе.

commentaries.griffith: Agni, thou art our Providence, our Father thou - we are thy brethren and thou art our spring of life. in thee, rich in good heroes, guard of high decrees, meet hundred, thousand treasures, O infallible!
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, art our guardian, thou art our father. Thou art the giver of strength; we are thy kinsmen. Hundredfold, thousandfold treasures come together in thee, who art rich in heroes, the guardian of the law, O undeceivable one.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni bist uns Vorsehung und Vater, du bist der Ernährer, wir sind deine Verwandten. Zu dir kommen die Reichtümer hundertfältig, tausendfältig zusammen, zu dem Meister, dem Gesetzeshüter, du Untrüglicher.
commentaries.grassmann: Fürsorger bist du, Agni, und ein Vater uns, du Jugend schaffend, deine Blutsverwandten wir; Es sammeln hundert, tausend Schätze sich bei dir, Untrüglicher, dem starken Ordnungschirmenden.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты, о Агни, заступничество, ты – отец наш, / Ты – создатель жизненной силы; мы – твои родные. / К тебе богатства сотенные, тысячные / Собираются – к очень сильному, к защитнику обета, о неподдающийся обману.

commentaries.griffith: Thee, Agni, have the Gods made the first living One for living man, Lord of the house of Nahusa. Ila they made the teacher of the sons of men, what time a Son was born to the father of my race.
commentaries.oldenberg: Thee, O Agni, the gods have made for the living as the first living 1, the clan-lord of the Nahusha 2. They have made (the goddess) Ilâ the teacher of men (manusha), when a son of my father is born 3.
commentaries.geldner: Dich Agni machten die Götter zum ersten Ayu für den Ayu, zum Stammesfürsten des Nahusa. Sie machten die Ila zur Lehrmeisterin des Menschen, wenn meiner Wenigkeit als dem Vater der Sohn Agni geboren wird.
commentaries.grassmann: Die Götter machten zu der Menschheit Fürsten dich, zum ersten Wandrer, Agni, dich den Wandernden, Sie machten Iḍa zu der Menschen Lehrerin zur Zeit, da meines Ahnherrn Sohn geboren ward.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Тебя, о Агни, первым Аю для Аю / Сделали боги, господином племени Нахуши. / Иду они сделали наставницей человека, / Чтобы от меня-отца сын (-Агни) рождался.

commentaries.griffith: Worthy to be revered, O Agni, God, preserve our wealthy patrons with thy succours, and ourselves. Guard of our seed art thou, aiding our cows to bear, incessantly protecting in thy holy way.
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, protect with thy guardians, O god, our liberal givers and ourselves, O venerable one! Thou art the protector of kith and kin 1 and of the cows, unremittingly watching over thy law.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni beschütze mit deinen Wächtern, o Gott, die Lohnherren und uns selbst, du Löblicher! Du bist der Schirmer des Samens in der leiblichen Nachkommenschaft und der Rinder, wachsam, ohne in deinem Dienste die Augen zu schließen.
commentaries.grassmann: Beschirm durch deine Hüter, Agni, uns, o Gott, die Opfergeber und uns selbst, o preislicher, Du schützest Kinder, Enkel, Rinder uns, sie schlummerlos bewachend stets bei deinem Werk.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты, о Агни, с помощью твоих хранителей, о бог, / Защищай наших щедрых (покровителей) и нас самих, о достойный восхваления! / Ты – спаситель потомства – чтобы оно длилось – (и) коров, / Охраняющий, не смыкая глаз, (все что есть) в твоем завете.

commentaries.griffith: Agni, thou art a guard close to the pious man; kindled art thou, four-eyed! for him who is unarmcd. With fond heart thou acceptest e'en the poor man's prayer, when he hath brought his gift to gain security.
commentaries.oldenberg: 1 Thou, O Agni, art kindled four-eyed, as the closest guardian for the sacrificer who is without (even) a quiver 2. Thou acceptest in thy mind the hymn even of the poor 3 who has made offerings 4, that he may prosper without danger.
commentaries.geldner: Du, Agni, wirst entzündet als der vertraute vieräugige Wächter für den unbewehrten Opferer. Wer Opfer spendet, um sich Sicherheit zu schaffen - auch des an Geist Armen Dichterspruch - den begehrst du.
commentaries.grassmann: Dem Frommen bist der nächste Hüter, Agni, du, vieräugig wirst dem unbewehrten du entflammt; Du nimmst den Spruch des Sängers gerne an, der dir mit Opfern naht, zu nähren den, der nie verletzt.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты, о Агни, как ближайший защитник для жертвователя / Безоружного, зажигаешься, четырехглазый. / Кто принес жертву, чтоб обеспечить безопасность, / Тот стих (его) – даже если он слаб – ты возлюбишь сердцем.

commentaries.griffith: Thou, Agni gainest for the loudly-praising priest the highest wealth, the object of a man's desire. Thou art called Father, caring even for the weak, and wisest, to the simple one thou teachest lore.
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, gainest 1 for the widely-renowned worshipper that property which is desirable and excellent. Thou art called the guardian and father even of the weak 2; thou instructest the simple, thou, the greatest sage, the quarters of the world 3.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni gewinnst für den Sänger, dessen Worte weit reichen, das was wünschenswerter höchster Besitz ist. Du heißest die Vorsehung, der Vater auch des Armen. Du belehrest den Unerfahrenen, du gibst Weisungen als der Kundigere.
commentaries.grassmann: Du, Agni, schenkst dem Beter, welcher laut dich ruft,den besten Reichthum, der von vielen, wird begehrt, Des Armen Vater und Versorger heissest du, den Thoren strafst und lehrest du, o weisester.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты, о Агни, для жреца, чьи слова разносятся далеко, / Добываешь то, что (есть) высшее вожделенное богатство, / Ты зовешься заступничеством даже для несчастного, отцом (его). / Ты наставляешь простака, на(зываешь ему) направления как более сведущий.

commentaries.griffith: Agni, the man who giveth guerdon to the priests, like well-sewn armour thou guardest on every side. He who with grateful food shows kindness in his house, an offerer to the living, is the type of heaven.
commentaries.oldenberg: Thou, O Agni, protectest on every side like well-stitched armour the man who gives sacrificial fees. He who puts sweet food (before the priests), who makes them comfortable in his dwelling, who kills living (victims), he (will reside) high in heaven 1.
commentaries.geldner: Du Agni schützest den Mann, der Dichtersold gewährt, nach allen Seiten wie ein fest genähter Panzer. Wer süße Speise vorsetzt, in seiner Wohnung ein gutes Lager bereitet und ein lebendes Tier opfert, der kommt zuoberst im Himmel.
commentaries.grassmann: Den Mann, o Agni, der die Opfergabe schenkt, umschirmst du wie ein festgefügter Panzer rings; Wer Süsses zutheilt, holdes wirkend in dem Haus, Lebend'ges opfert, der ist nah dem Himmel schon.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Ты, о Агни, мужа, получившего жертвенное вознаграждение, / Охраняешь со всех сторон, как (хорошо) сшитый щит. / Кто подает сладкое блюдо, готовит мягкое ложе в жилище (своем), / Жертвует живое жертвенное животное, тот попадает в высшую часть неба.

commentaries.griffith: Pardon, we pray, this sin of ours, O Agni, -- the path which we have trodden, widely straying, Dear Friend and Father, caring for the pious, who speedest nigh and who inspirest mortals.
commentaries.oldenberg: Forgive, O Agni, this our fault (?) 1, (look graciously at) this way which we have wandered from afar. Thou art the companion, the guardian, the father of those who offer Soma; thou art the quick one 2 who makes the mortals Rishis 3.
commentaries.geldner: Verzeih uns, Agni, diesen Ungehorsam, den Weg, den wir von Ferne gekommen sind! Du bist Freund, Vater, Vorsehung der Somapfleger, du bist der eifrige Rishimacher der Sterblichen.
commentaries.grassmann: Verzeih, o Agni, diese unsre Sünde, den Weg, den wir entfernt von dir gegangen, Du bist der Frommen Vater, Freund, Versorger, bist eifriger Begeisterer der Menschen.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Это, о Агни, прегрешение прости нам, / Это путь, которым мы пришли издалека. / Ты друг, отец, заступничество для приносящих сому, / Ты ревностный создатель риши для смертных.

commentaries.griffith: As erst to Manus, to Yayiti, Angiras, so Angiras! pure Agni! come thou to our hall Bring hither the celestial host and seat them here upon the sacred grass, and offer what they love.
commentaries.oldenberg: As thou didst for Manus, O Agni, for Angiras, O Angiras, for Yayâti on thy (priestly) seat, as for the ancients, O brilliant one, come hither, conduct hither the host of the gods, seat them on the sacrificial grass, and sacrifice to the beloved (host).
commentaries.geldner: Wie bei Manu, o Agni, wie bei Angiras, du Angiras, wie bei Yayati, wie früher an deinem Sitze, du Reiner- komm herbei, fahre das göttliche Volk her, laß es sich auf das Barhis setzen und opfere dem lieben!
commentaries.grassmann: Wie früher einst bei Manus, wie bei Angiras, Jajati, nah dich, Agni, Bote, unserm Sitz, O reiner, fahre her das göttliche Geschlecht, setz auf die Streu das liebe und verehre es.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Как у Ману, о Агни, как у Ангираса, о Ангирас, / Как у Яяти, как прежде, на свое место, о чистый, – / Приди, привези божественный род, / Усади на жертвенную солому, принеси жертву милому (их роду)!

commentaries.griffith: By this our prayer be thou, O Agni, strengthened, prayer made by us after our power and knowledge. Lead thou us, therefore, to increasing riches; endow us with thy strength-bestowing favour.
commentaries.oldenberg: Be magnified, O Agni, through this spell which we have made for thee with our skill or with our knowledge. And lead us forward to better things. Let us be united with thy favour, which bestows strength.
commentaries.geldner: Erbaue dich an dieser Beschwörung, o Agni, die wir dir nach bestem Können oder Wissen gemacht haben. Und geleite uns zum Glück, begabe uns mit lohnbringender Gnade!
commentaries.grassmann: Durch dies Gebet, o Agni, lass dich stärken, das wir gemacht nach Wissen und Vermögen Und führe uns zu höherm Glücke vorwärts, beströme uns mit gabenreicher Güte.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Укрепи себя, о Агни, этой молитвой, / Что мы тебе сотворили, или силой нашей, или знанием! / Привези нас также к лучшему! / Одари нас благосклонностью, дающей награду!

commentaries.griffith: I WILL declare the manly deeds of Indra, the first that he achieved, the Thunder-wielder. He slew the Dragon, then disclosed the waters, and cleft the channels of the mountain torrents.
commentaries.macdonell: I will proclaim the manly deeds of Indra, The first that he performed, the lightning-wielder. He slew the serpent, then discharged the waters, And cleft the caverns of the lofty mountains.
commentaries.geldner: Des Indra Heldentaten will ich nun verkünden, die ersten, die der Keulenträger getan hat: Er erschlug den Drachen, erbrach die Gewässer; er spaltete die Weichen der Berge.
commentaries.grassmann: Jetzt will ich Indra's Heldenthaten singen, die ersten, die des Blitzes Herr vollbracht hat; Er schlug den Drachen, liess die Wasser strömen und spaltete der Wolkenberge Bäuche.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Индры героические деяния сейчас я хочу провозгласить: / Те первые, что совершил громовержец, / Он убил змея, он просверлил (русла) вод, / Он рассек недра гор.

commentaries.griffith: He slew the Dragon lying on the mountain: his heavenly bolt of thunder Tvastar fashioned. Like lowing kine in rapid flow descending the waters glided downward to the ocean.
commentaries.macdonell: He slew the serpent lying on the mountain: For him the whizzing bolt has Tvaṣṭar fashioned. Like lowing cows, with rapid current flowing, The waters to the ocean down have glided.
commentaries.geldner: Er erschlug den Drachen, der sich auf dem Berge gelagert hatte. Tvastri hatte ihm die sausende Keule geschmiedet. Wie die brüllenden Kühe zu den Kälbern eilend liefen die Gewässer stracks zum Meere.
commentaries.grassmann: Er schlug den Drachen, welcher auf dem Berg lag; die Waffe saust, die Tvaschtar ihm gezimmert, Wie Kühe brüllend eilten flugs die Wasser in Fluten strömend zu dem Meere nieder.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Он убил, змея, покоившегося на горе. / Тваштар ему выточил шумную дубину. / Как мычащие коровы, устремившись (к телятам), / Прямо к морю сбегают воды.

commentaries.griffith: Impetuous as a bull, he chose the Soma and in three sacred beakers drank the juices. Maghavan grasped the thunder for his weapon, and smote to death this firstborn of the dragons.
commentaries.macdonell: Impetuous like a bull he chose the Soma, And drank in threefold vessels of its juices. The bounteous god grasped lightning for his missile; He struck down dead that first-born of the serpents.
commentaries.geldner: Gierig wie ein Stier erwählte er sich den Soma; in den Trikadruka´s trank er vom ausgepreßten. Der Gabenreiche ergriff das Wurfgeschoß, die Keule; er erschlug ihn, den Erstgeborenen der Drachen.
commentaries.grassmann: Als brünst'ger Stier ersah er sich den Soma, aus den drei Eimern trank er den gebrauten, Als Waffe nahm den Blitz der allgewalt'ge, und tödtete der Drachen erstgebornen.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Разъяренный, как бык, он выбрал себе сому, / Он напился (сомы), выжатого в трех сосудах. / Щедрый схватил метательный снаряд – ваджру. / Он убил его, перворожденного из змеев.

commentaries.griffith: When, Indra, thou hadst slain the dragon's firstborn, and overcome the charms of the enchanters, Then, giving life to Sun and Dawn and Heaven, thou foundest not one foe to stand against thee.
commentaries.macdonell: When thou hadst slain the first-born of the serpents, And thwarted all the wiles of crafty schemers, Anon disclosing sun, and dawn, and heaven, Thou truly foundest not a foe, O Indra.
commentaries.geldner: Als du, Indra, den Erstgeborenen der Drachen erschlugst und da die Listen der Listigen noch überlistetest, da du Sonne, Himmel, Morgenröte zum Vorschein brachtest, da hast du fortab nimmer deinen Meister gefunden.
commentaries.grassmann: Als, Indra, du der Drachen erstgebornen erschlugst, da tilgtest du der List'gen Listen, Und Sonne, Tag und Morgenröthe zeugend hast keinen Feind du damals mehr gefunden.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Когда ты, Индра, убил перворожденного из змеев / И перехитрил хитрости хитрецов, / И породил солнце, небо, утреннюю зарю, / С тех пор ты уже в самом деле не находил противника.

commentaries.griffith: Indra with his own great and deadly thunder smote into pieces Vrtra, worst of Vrtras. As trunks of trees, what time the axe hath felled them, low on the earth so lies the prostrate Dragon.
commentaries.macdonell: Indra slew Vṛtra and one worse than Vṛtra, Vyaṃsa, with lightning, his resistless weapon: Like trunks of trees, with axes hewn in pieces, The serpent clinging to the earth lay prostrate.
commentaries.geldner: Indra erschlug den Vritra, den größten Feind, den Schulterlosen mit der Keule, seiner großen Waffe. Wie Baumstämme, die mit der Axt gefällt sind, liegt der Drache platt auf der Erde.
commentaries.grassmann: Den Vritra und den schlimmeren Viansa schlug Indra mit dem Blitz, mit mächt'gem Hiebe, Wie Baumgeäst vom Beile abgehauen, liegt hingestreckt der Drache auf der Erde.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Он убил Вритру, самого (страшного) врага, бесплечего, / Индра – дубиной, великим оружием. / Как ветви топором обрубленные, / Змей лежит, прильнув к земле.

commentaries.griffith: He, like a mad weak warrior, challenged Indra, the great impetuous many-slaying Hero. He. brooking not the clashing of the weapons, crushed-Indra's foe-the shattered forts in falling.
commentaries.macdonell: He like a drunken coward challenged Indra, The headlong, many-crushing, mighty hero. He parried not the onset of the weapons: The foe of Indra, falling, crushed the channels.
commentaries.geldner: Denn er hatte wie ein des Kämpfens Unkundiger in trunkenem Übermut den großen Helden, den Starkbedrängenden, Trestersomatrinkenden herausgefordert. Er hat den Anprall seiner Waffen nicht ausgehalten; der Nasenbrecher wurde zerschmettert, als er in Indra seinen Meister fand.
commentaries.grassmann: Denn wie ein trunkner Feigling hatt' den Helden den tilgenden, gewalt'gen er gefordert, Er hielt nicht aus den Andrang seiner Hiebe, im Sturz zerbrach der Indrafeind die Klüfte.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Как плохой боец в пьяном угаре он вызвал / Великого героя, покоряющего силой, пьющего выжимки сомы. / Он не выдержал натиска его оружия: / Безликий от пролома, он раздавлен – тот, кому Индра враг.

commentaries.griffith: Footless and handless still he challenged Indra, who smote him with his bolt between the shoulders. Emasculate yet claiming manly vigour, thus Vrtra lay with scattered limbs dissevered.
commentaries.macdonell: Footless and handless he with Indra battled, Who smote him then upon his back with lightning. But, impotent, he strove to match the hero: He lay with scattered limbs in many places.
commentaries.geldner: Ohne Hand und Fuß kämpfte er gegen Indra. Er schlug ihm die Keule in den Nacken. Der verschnittene Stier, der dem Bullen gewachsen sein wollte, der Vritra lag zerstückt an vielen Stellen da.
commentaries.grassmann: Fusslos und handlos stritt er wider Indra; der schleuderte den Blitz auf seinen Rücken, Der mit dem Stier sich messen wollt', der Hämmling, Vritra lag da zerstückt an vielen Orten.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Безногий, безрукий боролся он против Индры. / Тот ударил его дубиной по спине. / Вол, хотевший стать противником быка, / Вритра лежал, разбросанный по разным местам.

commentaries.griffith: There as he lies like a bank-bursting river, the waters taking courage flow above him. The Dragon lies beneath the feet of torrents which Vrtra with his greatness had encompassed.
commentaries.macdonell: As thus he lay, like broken reed, the waters, Now courage taking, surge across his body. He lies beneath the very feet of rivers Which Vṛtra with his might had close encompassed.
commentaries.geldner: Über ihn, der wie geschnittenes Rohr nur so dalag, gingen aufsteigend die Gewässer des Manu hinweg. Die ein Vritra in seiner Größe umlagert hatte, zu deren Füßen lag der Drache.
commentaries.grassmann: Und über ihn, der dalag wie ein Schlachtvieh, geht lustig steigend nun die Flut der Wasser; Die Vritra kräftig rings umschlossen hatte, zu deren Füssen lag nun da der Drachen.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Через (него), безжизненно лежащего, как раскрошенный тростник, / Текут вздымаясь воды Ману. / (Те,) кого Вритра (некогда) с силой сковывал, / У их ног лежал теперь змей.

commentaries.griffith: Then humbled was the strength of Vrtra's mother: Indra hath cast his deadly bolt against her. The mother was above, the son was under and like a cow beside her calf lay Danu.
commentaries.macdonell: The strength began to fail of Vṛtra's mother, For Indra had cast down his bolt upon her. Above the mother was, the son was under; And like a cow beside her calf lies Dānu.
commentaries.geldner: Zur Neige ging die Lebenskraft der Mutter des Vritra; Indra hatte die Waffe auf sie geschleudert. Obenauf lag die Erzeugerin, zuunterst der Sohn. Die Danu liegt wie die Kuh bei ihrem Kalbe.
commentaries.grassmann: Erschöpft an Kraft war da des Vritra Mutter, und Indra schlug hinweg nun ihre Waffe; Der Sohn lag unten, oben drauf die Mutter, die Hexe liegt wie mit dem Kalb die Milchkuh.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Поникла жизненная сила у той, чей сын – Вритра. / Индра сбросил на нее смертельное оружие. / Сверху – родительница, внизу был сын. / Дану лежит, как корова с теленком.

commentaries.griffith: Rolled in the midst of never-ceasing currents flowing without a rest for ever onward. The waters bear off Vrtra's nameless body: the foe of Indra sank to during darkness.
commentaries.macdonell: The waters deep have hidden Vṛtra's body, Plunged in the midst of never-ceasing torrents That stand not still, but ever hasten onward: Indra's fierce foe sank down to lasting darkness.
commentaries.geldner: Inmitten der nie stillstehenden, nie rastenden Wasserläufe war sein Leib begraben. Die Gewässer fließen über Vritra´s Heimlichkeit hinweg. In langes Dunkel versank der Indrabemeisterte.
commentaries.grassmann: Es lag sein Leichnam mitten unter Strömen, die nimmer stillstehn, nimmer Einkehr halten, Entrückt dem Vritra rinnen die Gewässer, der Indrafeind sank hin in langes Dunkel.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Среди неостанавливающихся, неуспокаивающихся / Водяных дорожек скрыто тело. / Воды текут через тайное место Вритры. / В долгий мрак погрузился тот, кому Индра враг.

commentaries.griffith: Guarded by Ahi stood the thralls of Dasas, the waters stayed like kine held by the robber. But he, when he had smitten Vrtra, opened the cave wherein the floods had been imprisoned.
commentaries.macdonell: Enclosed by demons, guarded by a serpent, The waters stood like cows by Paṇi captured. The waters' orifice that was obstructed. When Vṛtra he had smitten, Indra opened.
commentaries.geldner: Als Frauen des Dasa vom Drachen bewacht, waren die Gewässer eingesperrt wie die Kühe von dem Pani. Den Ausfluß der Gewässer, der verstopft war, hat er nach Erschlagung des Vritra geöffnet.
commentaries.grassmann: Beherrscht vom Feinde und bewacht vom Drachen, wie Küh' umhegt vom Räuber, stand das Wasser, Der Wasser Höhle, die verschlossne, hat er geöffnet, als den Vritra er erschlagen.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Жены Дасы, охраняемые змеем, – воды / Стояли скованные, как коровы (, спрятанные) Пани. / Проход для вод, который был заткнут, – / Он открыл ему, убив Вритру.

commentaries.griffith: A horse's tail wast thou when he, O Indra, smote on thy bolt; thou, God without a second, Thou hast won back the kine, hast won the Soma; thou hast let loose to flow the Seven Rivers.
commentaries.macdonell: A horse's tail thou didst become, O Indra, When, on his spear impaled, as god unaided, The cows, O hero, thou didst win and Soma, And free the seven streams to flow in torrents.
commentaries.geldner: In ein Roßhaar verwandeltest du dich da, Indra, als er dich gegen die Zacke schlug. Der einzige Gott erobertest du die Kühe, du erobertest, o Held, den Soma; du ließest die sieben Ströme frei, daß sie laufen.
commentaries.grassmann: Du warst ein Rossschweif, Indra, als er damals im Schuss dich traf; du, der allein du Gott bist, Gewannst die Kühe, Held, gewannst den Soma, und rinnen liessest du die sieben Ströme.
commentaries.elizarenkova: В конский волос превратился ты, о Индра, в тот миг, / Когда он дал тебе по клыку. Единый бог, / Ты завоевал коров, ты завоевал сому, о герой! / Ты выпустил для бега семь потоков.

commentaries.griffith: Nothing availed him lightning, nothing thunder, hailstorm or mist which had spread around him: When Indra and the Dragon strove in battle, Maghavan gained the victory for ever.
commentaries.macdonell: Him lightning then availèd not nor thunder, Nor mist, nor hailstorm which around he scattered: When Indra and the serpent fought in battle, The bounteous god gained victory for ever.
commentaries.geldner: Nicht fruchtete ihm Blitz und Donner, nicht Nebel und Hagel, den er ausstreute. Als Indra und der Drache kämpften, da blieb der Gabenreiche auch für alle Zukunft Sieger.
commentaries.grassmann: Nichts half ihm da der Blitz und nichts der Donner, nicht Nebel, den er ausgoss, noch der Hagel, Als Indra und der Drache sich bekämpften, gewann den Sieg für alle Zeit der mächt'ge.
commentaries.elizarenkova: a-b nasmai vidyun na tanuatuh sisedha / na yam miham rv01.032.13

commentaries.griffith: Whom sawest thou to avenge the Dragon, Indra, that fear possessed thy heart when thou hadst slain him; That, like a hawk affrighted through the regions, thou crossedst nine-and-ninety flowing rivers?
commentaries.macdonell: Whom saw'st thou as avenger of the serpent, As terror seized thy heart when thou hadst slain him, And thou didst cross the nine and ninety rivers And air's broad spaces, like a hawk affrighted?
commentaries.geldner: Wen sahst du, Indra, als Rächer des Drachen, daß Furcht dein, des Töters, Herz befiel, als du über die neunundneunzig Ströme, wie der Adler erschreckt die Räume durcheiltest?
commentaries.grassmann: Wen sahst du, Indra, als des Drachens Rächer, als dir dem Sieger damals Furcht ins Herz schlich, Als du die Flut der neunundneunzig Ströme, die Luft durchflogst wie ein erschreckter Falke?
commentaries.elizarenkova: Какого мстителя за змея увидел ты, о Индра, / Что в сердце к тебе, убийце, проник страх, / Когда девяносто и девять потоков / Ты пересекал, как испуганный орел – пространства?

commentaries.griffith: Indra is King of all that moves and moves not, of creatures tame and horned, the Thunder-wielder. Over all living men he rules as Sovran, containing all as spokes within the felly.
commentaries.macdonell: Indra is king of all that's fixed and moving, Of tame and horned beasts, the thunder-wielder. He truly rules, as king of busy mortals; Them he encompasses as spokes the felly.
commentaries.geldner: Indra ist König über den Fahrenden, den Rastenden, über Zahmes und Gehörntes, der die Keule im Arm trägt. Er gebietet als König über die Völker; wie der Radkranz die Speichen umfaßt er das alles.
commentaries.grassmann: Was geht und steht, beherrscht als König Indra, das arbeitsame Vieh und das gehörnte, Den Blitz im Arm beherrscht er alle Menschen, umfasst sie wie des Rades Kranz die Speichen.
commentaries.elizarenkova: Индра – царь движущегося (и) отдыхающего, / Безрогого и рогатого, громовержец. / Это он как царь правит народами. / Как обод – спицы (колеса), он охватил их (всех).

commentaries.griffith: Come, fain for booty let us seek to Indra: yet more shall he increase his care that guides us. Will not the Indestructible endow us with perfect knowledge of this wealth, of cattle?
commentaries.geldner: Kommt, wir wollen Indra angehen, die wir auf die Kühe aus sind. Er möge fest seine Fürsorge für uns mehren. Vielleicht daß er, der kein Hindernis kennt, dann unserem höchsten Wunsch nach diesem Reichtum, nach Kühen geneigt sein wird.
commentaries.grassmann: Auf, lasst uns Indra Heerden heischend angehn, dass er für uns recht seine Sorge steigre; Wird dann der unbesiegte unsrer höchsten Begier nach Schatz und Rindern nicht sich fügen?
commentaries.elizarenkova: Придите! Мы пойдем к Индре, желая коров: / Да усилит он как следует заботу о нас! / Он, несокрушимый, уж не пренебрежет ли / Крайним стремлением нашим к этому богатству, к коровам?

commentaries.griffith: I fly to him invisible Wealth-giver as flies the falcon to his cherished eyrie, With fairest hymns of praise adoring Indra, whom those who laud him must invoke in battle.
commentaries.geldner: Ich fliege hin zu dem Schatzspender, dem unwiderstehlichen, wie ein Adler zum gewohnten Horst, dem Indra mit höchsten Preisliedern huldigend, der für die Sänger auf seiner Fahrt anzurufen ist.
commentaries.grassmann: Zum unbezwungnen Reichthumspender flieg' ich, sowie der Adler zum willkommnen Neste, Verehrend Indra mit den höchsten Liedern, der von den Sängern anzuflehn beim Fest ist.
commentaries.elizarenkova: И вот я к этому дарителю богатств, неотразимому (богу), / Лечу, словно сокол – к излюбленному жилью, / Прославляя Индру самыми высокими песнями, / (Того,) кого должны призывать певцы, когда он в пути.

commentaries.griffith: Mid all his host, he bindeth on the quiver he driveth cattle from what foe he pleaseth: Gathering up great store of riches, Indra. be thou no trafficker with us, most mighty.
commentaries.geldner: In voller Wehr hat er die Köcher umgehängt. Die Rinder des Protzen treibt er zu, wem er will. Viel Gut aufstöbernd, sei kein Pani gegen uns, du starker Indra!
commentaries.grassmann: Den Köcher hing sich an der Herr der Scharen, treibt, wie er will, die Rinder fort des Feindes; Der viele Güter du bewahrst, o Indra, sei gegen uns nicht kärglich, o gewalt'ger.
commentaries.elizarenkova: При полном вооружении, он увешал себя колчанами. / Он угоняет коров чужого – у кого хочет. / Сгребая себе много добра, о Индра, / Не будь скупым к нам, о возросший!
